contract.purpose: Explain BrowserDaddy history and measured attention honestly, with app artwork only.

contract.driftNote: Native private-window protection is not claimed as qualified; optional external classifier transmission is explicitly disclosed.

contract.job: Understand history versus measured attention and inspect development availability.

contract.risk: Artwork provides less capability proof than screenshots; owner explicitly chose privacy-safe artwork only.
